purpose: Map the requested end-to-end research workflow to verified local skills and evidence-bound adapters.

autoresearch.role: fixed evaluation, experiment protocol, train.py boundary

daily_papers.role: paper fetch, review and notes pipeline

paper_reader.role: paper analysis, equations, figures and evidence extraction

ppt_master.role: presentation narrative, layout and editable PPTX handoff

sivia.role: source-grounded scientific figures and figure review

route_map.implementation: research package with literature synthesis, innovation proposal, architecture draft and verification/ablation matrix
route_map.human_gate: human-edited innovation review followed by exact compute allocation

route_map.implementation: labctl analysis; descriptive stats and bootstrap CI only when n permits
route_map.human_gate: evidence snapshot and conclusion review before claims

route_map.implementation: Sivia for schematics; standard plotting for real results
evidence manifest + human-approved conclusion record + bilingual paper drafts
route_map.human_gate: human conclusion review with run references and exact wording

route_map.implementation: ppt-master + Sivia; pipeline emits ppt_brief.md from the evidence manifest
labctl summary weekly + boss_update.md + existing heartbeat

boundaries: literature is hypothesis input, not measured improvement
generated figures cannot represent empirical data
PPT narrative may be persuasive but cannot invent metrics, curves or samples
